note: Zimbabwe: the Immigration Act (Chapter 4:02, s. 19) has the Minister provide temporary employment permits by regulation, the permit for temporary work. The regulations themselves weren't read. No days without it.

sources.title: Immigration Act [Chapter 4:02] (Department of Immigration Zimbabwe), s. 19
sources.said: In regulations in terms of section forty-one the Minister— ... shall provide for students permits, temporary employment permits and temporary permits;
